name: Orascom Development Holding
source: Orascom Development Holding AG, consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (audited, Deloitte AG), consolidated statement of comprehensive income pages F-3 to F-4 and consolidated statement of financial position pages F-5 to F-6. Currency CHF, absolute. Cost of Sales folds in 'Impairment losses recognised on receivables, net' under the convention already used for FY2024 in this file. Net Profit is profit for the year from CONTINUING operations, the same convention as FY2024. Operating Expenses is the 'Administrative expenses' line (its FY2024 comparative equals the stored FY2024 value). EPS is not printed anywhere in this document, so the FY2025 cell is left empty rather than estimated. Ratios are computed: ROE = Net Profit / Total Equity, ROA = Net Profit / Total Assets, margins = the ratio to Revenue, Debt to Equity = Total Liabilities / Total Equity.
note: Consolidated statement of comprehensive income, continuing operations, expressed in CHF (absolute units, not thousands). Cost of Sales includes impairment losses recognised on receivables, net, which the issuer nets inside gross profit (FY2024: 786939; FY2023: 534715). Net Profit is the profit for the year from continuing operations as printed; the printed profit for the year including discontinued operations is 8269737 (FY2023: 54389693) and the (loss)/gain from discontinued operations is (9310759) (FY2023: 2000173). EPS is basic earnings per share from continuing operations as printed; including discontinued operations the printed basic EPS is (0.10) (FY2023: 0.51).
